title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Delivering Analysis Views in AL Extensions

chapters.title: Exporting Analysis Views and JSON Definition
Implementing Analysis Views in AL Extensions
Deploying and Using Extension Analysis Views
Duplicating, Hiding and Managing Analysis Views

features.name: Analysis Views Export to AL Extensions
features.description: Ability to export analysis tabs defined in web client as JSON files and deliver them with AL extensions. This allows persisting analysis tabs, sharing them across users and environments, and creating predefined analysis views based on common scenarios.
features.status_evidence_quote: For today, I'm going to show you a new feature that is coming up with the next release.
caveats: Analysis views from extensions are read-only
Users can duplicate read-only views to create editable versions

features.name: Analysis View Descriptions
features.description: New capability to add descriptions to analysis views that provide context and help users understand how to use each tab.

features.name: Analysis View Definition Property in AL
features.description: New AL syntax for adding analysis views to page extensions using a definition_file property that points to a JSON file containing the analysis view configuration.
features.status_evidence_quote: this new syntax that is also coming up with this release uh for analysis views.

features.name: Analysis View Customization via Page Customization
features.description: Ability to create page customizations with analysis views and assign them to profiles or profile extensions to tailor analysis tabs for different user groups.

features.name: Analysis View Lock Icon for Extension Origins
features.description: Analysis views delivered via extensions display a lock icon to indicate they come from an extension and are not editable by users.
caveats: Read-only views cannot be filtered, sorted, or grouped

features.name: Analysis View Duplication
features.description: Users can duplicate read-only analysis views from extensions to create their own editable copies for advanced data analysis with full filtering and pivoting capabilities.

features.name: Analysis View Hide and Personalization
features.description: Users can hide analysis views through a menu option, and hidden views can be managed through personalization mode with options to show or hide specific views.
